verdict.rationale: Temporal exposes generic primitives — Signals for external events, Schedules for time-based triggers, and repeatable Workflow executions — that developers can combine to build debounce/batch/delay logic, but the evidence never documents a first-class debounce or event-collapsing feature. missing for 10: explicit debounce/batch pattern documentation, dedicated event-coalescing API, and independent confirmation that teams use Temporal specifically for noisy-stream collapsing.
